sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orange_pos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
def greens():
    return sorted((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
print("start:", orange_pos(), "greens:", greens())
for i in range(4):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"L{i+1}:", orange_pos(), "greens:", greens(), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
